task.title: Draft a held-out generation
task.shortdesc: Draft the TPU7x topic set on , then compare each draft with the topic Google published.

context.p: Each draft calls , so the page allows public drafts a day. The page shows the latest run while you wait, so you can read a run without drafting.

step.cmd: In Generation, select TPU7x (Ironwood), held out.

info.p: Each topic moves through the agent's stages: find_siblings, load_facts, build_schema, generate_topic, checks, revise and open_pr. A set takes about a minute.

step.cmd: When the run finishes, select a topic tab to see the draft beside the published topic.
Select Download drafts and report (.zip) to keep the DITA topics and the reports.

result.p: The scorecard at the top of the page updates with the run's measured values.

postreq.p: If the page says today's drafts are used up, it shows the latest run instead. Try again the next day (UTC).
